fields.System.Title: TRF-202 — Pack for transfer
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a packer at the origin, I want to record how transfer stock is packed onto pallets or
cartons, so that the destination can check the delivery unit by unit.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given picked transfer stock, then it can be packed into cartons or pallets with
  • recorded contents.
  • - Given a packed unit, then it carries a unique reference the destination will scan.
  • - Given batch or serial tracked products, then the batch and serials are recorded per
  • packed unit.
  • - Given packing, then contents are verified against what was picked.
  • - Given the packed units, then they form the dispatch record used by
  • [TRF-302](TRF-302-validate-against-dispatch.md).

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | transfers, outbound |
| Tables | carton, carton_content, transfer_shipment |
| Risks | Incomplete dispatch record makes receipt validation impossible ([doc 09 §9.3](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md)) |
| Tests | unit · integration |
